newsitem.title: CHINA: China seeks better trade ties with Singapore-paper.
newsitem.headline: China seeks better trade ties with Singapore-paper.

text.p: China has told visiting Singapore elder statesman Lee Kuan Yew that it wants closer economic and trade ties with the island state, the official People's Daily said on Tuesday.

"China is willing to work with Singapore to upgrade bilateral economic and trade cooperation," the newspaper quoted Vice-Premier Li Lanqing as saying in a meeting with the Singaporean minister on Monday.
The two discussed other issues of common concern during the meeting, the newspaper said without giving details.
Lee Kuan Yew, who resigned as Singapore's prime minister in 1990 and is now senior minister, is heading a delegation that will be in China until September 11.
Lee is scheduled to meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin, Premier Li Peng and Li Ruihuan, head of a parliamentary body that serves as an advisory group to the government.
